name: Elite-Habit
description: Elite Habit is Daily Routine Management that make workout and daily essential manage with time and provide full reminder and track fitness

paragraphs: A comprehensive task management and fitness routine organizer designed to help you build elite daily habits, track hypertrophy workouts, and manage your schedule seamlessly.
features: Daily Task Arrangement: Organize your schedule with intuitive to-do lists, priority flags, and habit trackers to ensure you stay on top of your goals.
Fitness Routine Builder: Pre-configured and fully customizable workout logs perfect for 3-day or 5-day muscle-building and hypertrophy splits.
Diet & Nutrition Planning: Tools to log high-calorie meals and track daily macros to support your physical fitness milestones.
Progress Dashboard: Visual analytics tracking your habit consistency, workout volume progression, and daily task completion rates.
Modern UI/UX: A clean, distraction-free aesthetic designed for quick logging and seamless user experience.
